faq.answer: Enter your name and email here to unlock the template link. Open it in Notion and click Duplicate at the top right, then sign in and choose your own workspace. Website signup also subscribes you to The AI Business newsletter.

faq.question: What do I need to run it?
faq.answer: You need a Notion account to save your copy, plus a Claude account connected to Notion to use Claude as the operator. Follow the setup guide in your copy. Claude usage limits and any paid account or add-on costs are separate from the free template.

faq.question: Does Claude send messages or sync my inbox automatically?
faq.answer: No. You tell Claude what happened and send messages yourself. The core workflow does not capture email activity automatically or run follow-ups in the background.

faq.question: Can it replace a CRM for a sales team?
faq.answer: It is designed around founders and solo sellers. It does not provide a team CRM’s automatic activity capture, sending sequences, call recording, per-rep reporting or consent tracking. Read the limits page before using it.

longDescription: Your CRM can show a busy pipeline while new leads wait, follow-ups slip and proposals go quiet. This free 11-page guide helps B2B founders and sales leaders use AI to inspect their CRM data and turn those gaps into actions with owners and deadlines.

Six follow-up prompts help you draft replies, investigate one area, review losses, clean up records, estimate a forecast and compare next week with this week.

The workflow asks for evidence and confidence levels and stays read-only unless you request changes. The guide includes a fictional Fellgate IT example and a weekly review routine. Results depend on the records your AI can access; missing activity history limits what it can conclude. Spot-check findings against your CRM before acting.

faq.question: How can AI help find revenue leaks in a CRM?
faq.answer: Give it deal, lead and activity records, then use the guide’s prompt to check slow replies, overdue or missing next steps, deals going quiet and recurring patterns. The brief names records, dates, owners and amounts. Pipeline value at risk is not a prediction or guarantee of recovered revenue.

faq.question: Is this a single prompt or a PDF guide?
faq.answer: It is an 11-page PDF guide with setup instructions, an export checklist, a main prompt in two parts, six follow-up prompts, a fictional example brief and a weekly review routine.

faq.question: Can I use the guide without a CRM connector?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide gives a CSV route: export deals, activities and recent leads or contacts, then attach them to an AI tool that accepts file uploads. A spreadsheet can also supply the records. Start with the last 90 days, or more for a longer sales cycle.

faq.question: What do I need, and will the AI change my CRM?
faq.answer: You need permission to use the records and an AI tool with the connection or file-upload access you need. Available connections, plans and admin requirements vary; check the current directory in your tool. The prompts instruct the AI to read only and draft messages without sending them or changing CRM records. Missing data limits the analysis, so spot-check its findings.
